#include <assert.h>

#include <stdio.h>

#include "ts_pack.h"

int main(void) {
    TS_PACKAlefHandle config_handle = ts_pack_process_config_from_json("{\"language\":\"kitty\"}");
    TS_PACKAlefHandle result = ts_pack_process("font_size 12\n", config_handle);
    ts_pack_process_config_free(config_handle);
